主要内容: Danone is intensifying its efforts in the U.S. bottled water market, where it is competing against major players like Coca-Cola. The French company reported a 3.9% increase in bottled-water sales during the first quarter of 2019, driven largely by the performance of its Evian brand in North America. To sustain growth and counterbalance the slow performance of its yogurt business, Evian entered into a distribution agreement with Keurig Dr Pepper Inc. in October 2018. This partnership has enabled Evian to expand its presence in U.S. convenience stores, increasing its market reach and visibility. The move reflects Danone's strategic focus on leveraging its premium water brand to capture a larger share of the competitive U.S. market.
